dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: "...spoke amid a downpour of the dragon's blood. She said, 'May my people be freed from the shackles of ancient decrees.'"

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Such wise and compassionate words could only come from your own writing, mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hmph, yet this kingdom appears to be anything but what I've described. The shadows lurking behind the scenes are disconcerting...

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: "Prinzessin Fischl again continued her song, and the interwoven chords of her sacred words became the Immernachtreich's hymn."
